description: Create procedural canonical VTuber template mesh with trimesh+numpy. Generate head (sphere), neck (cylinder), upper body (box) merged into single mesh with humanoid bone hierarchy and distance-based vertex groups.
steps: Implement procedural mesh: UV sphere head (r=0.08), cylinder neck (r=0.02, h=0.05), box body (0.15x0.12x0.08)
Define bone hierarchy: hips->spine->chest->neck->head, leftEye/rightEye as head children
Compute vertex groups using distance-based weights with scipy.sparse
Update assets/canonical_vtuber/topology.json with actual vertex/face counts
findings: Successfully generated canonical VTuber template with 2244 vertices and 4476 faces. Mesh components: head (UV sphere, 2210 verts), neck (cylinder, 26 verts), body (box, 8 verts). Bone hierarchy: hips->spine->chest->neck->head with leftEye/rightEye as head children. Distance-based vertex weights computed and saved to vertex_weights.json.
